jobs.title: Senior Manager, Product Management - Customer Resiliency Web and Mobile App Experience Lead
jobs.description:
Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology. We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

Why Team Card Customer Resiliency?

There has never been a better time to work at the heart of Capital One’s mission. The Card Customer Resiliency team has embarked on an unprecedented journey to modernize our technology, elevate the voice of our most vulnerable customers, and innovate rapidly to define industry norms of what caring for customers truly means. Every member of our team is united in our passion to treat customers with dignity, clarity and respect. We build the experiences that allow struggling customers to responsibly manage their debt and understand what is best for them in the long-run.

Approximately 1 in 4 adult Americans has a Capital One Card at any moment in time. Due to the excellence of our credit expertise in underwriting, we lend deeper than any of our competitors, at scale. Because of this, over 20 million of our Card customers typically go delinquent in a given year, the largest pool of DQ customers in America. Our team cares for these customers in their most vulnerable moment, whether it’s enabling relief when hurricanes hit or crafting affordable payment plans that work for our customers and for Capital One. Managing credit risk isn’t just about understanding access to credit, but holistically understanding what happens when that access doesn’t take the path intended.

The Customer Resiliency team, composed of Collections and Recoveries, is embedded within the Mainstreet Card team. We have end-to-end ownership of our customer and drive meaningful P&L impact each quarter.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Product Management to join the Customer Resiliency team and lead the Collections and Recoveries Web and Mobile experiences.

This is the place where the mission comes to life - we bring humanity and simplicity to customers in distress. We help customers use credit wisely. We’re helping change banking for good.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for the Collections and Recoveries customer experience via the mobile app and web presence - the channels of choice for a majority of our CR customers. This is a complex charter impacting millions of customers and driving hundreds of millions of dollars of business value every year. You’ll work with design, marketing, operations, compliance, business analysts, and data scientists to envision the future destination of CR experiences and bring those visions to life. This role is a people leader of product managers who oversee two web teams and two mobile teams.

The ideal candidate will:

Have product management experience working in both web and mobile full stack environments
Have people leadership experience
Have the balanced decision making, teamwork, and product skills to manage the Collections customer experiences
Have exceptional judgment and stakeholder management skills to create a unified customer experience roadmap that balances short-term urgent needs with experimenting for the future
Be comfortable in deep partnership with a broad coalition of functions; great decision making is a team sport and you need to be comfortable being all about the team
Deeply respect the importance of keeping our promises to customers and doing so in a provably well-managed way

Capital One Product Framework

In this role, you’ll be expected to demonstrate proficiency in five key areas which we consider to be the foundation for successful Product management:

Human Centered - Obsesses about internal and external customer needs to reimagine and innovate product solutions
Business Focused - Delivers game-changing outcomes by focusing on leverage and execution excellence
Technology Driven - Leverages technology to deliver innovative and resilient solutions that enable both near term and long term value
Integrated Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves complex problems to deliver outcomes while mitigating product risks
Transformational Leadership - Leads cross functional teams to solve customer problems and drive organizational alignment

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:
A Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Information Systems or a related quantitative field), Business or Marketing

OR

Bachelor's degree in any field and at least 4 years of Product Management experience

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience translating business strategy and analysis into consumer facing digital products

Summary:
As a Senior Manager, Business Analysis at Capital One, you will apply your strategic and analytical skills to major company challenges. You will lead and team with world-class professionals to develop and test strategies that ultimately impact the bottom line. And you'll do it all in a collaborative environment that values your insight, encourages you to take on new responsibility, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovation.

The Role | General Responsibilities

We’re seeking a Senior Business Manager, Product Strategy, to support strategic priorities for the Consumer Product (CDX) leadership team under Emily Roberts. CDX is an exciting space with diverse product responsibilities. The Consumer and Developer Experience (CDX) organization drives the critical platforms that power world-class digital engagement for our customers and best-in-class tools for the developers who build them. Our diverse portfolio spans the Capital One mobile app, advanced marketing and personalization engines, AI-driven platforms that transform how we build software, and essential enterprise risk and supplier capabilities. By unifying these consumer, developer, and enterprise operations, CDX accelerates our ability to modernize core systems, strengthen the company's risk posture, and deliver seamless experiences at massive scale.

The Senior Manager will join a horizontal product and strategy team that supports priorities across CDX. The product and strategy team serves as an internal engine for both vision and strategic alignment, occupying a unique space at the intersection of strategic advisory and product creation. We operate with the rigor of top-tier consulting to solve the organization’s hardest strategic questions, drive the annual planning process, and align our long-term priorities. At the same time, we are builders: we act as an innovation lab, developing prototypes and partnering closely with product and engineering teams to translate conceptual visions into tangible, scaled digital experiences. We are looking for someone who thrives in this duality—someone who is equally energized by big-picture questions about where the world is going, thorny problems that require a strategic mindset and close partnership with product and tech teams, and hands-on building.

Specifically, the Senior Manager will:

Lead the annual CDX strategy
Partner with CDX leaders to answer thorny strategic questions, using a consulting-style model
Lead priority strategic initiatives for CDX, such as AI transformation
Support the organization’s intelligence unit, providing analytics, landscape assessments, thematic deep dives, and more to help the organization see around corners and anticipate headwinds and tailwinds
Set the vision for long-term product innovation, including partnering with engineering to deliver product prototypes
Obsess about internal and external customer satisfaction by establishing trusted, close touch relationships with key stakeholders throughout the company
Contribute to CDX organization’s strategic capabilities (e.g., by developing and delivering trainings)
Role model AI adoption by inventing and spreading solutions that improve work efficiency, quality, and fun

Exceptional strategy and strategic problem-solving skills, with a record of answering hard questions in ambiguous areas

A strong product orientation, including a record of understanding customers’ needs and working backwards to deliver experiences and solutions that deliver results for the customer and the business
An innovation mindset, characterized by a future orientation, the ability to set a vision, and a willingness to push boundaries
Strong relationship-building skills that result in trusted partnerships across organizations
Ability to establish credibility with senior leaders and colleagues from different disciplines (e.g., data scientists, P&L owners, designers, engineers)
Intellectual curiosity: an interest in understanding and experimenting with new leading edge technologies, organizational models, and ways of thinking
Demonstrated ability to employ judgment and experience to make rapid and complex decision
Highly effective communication skills (both written and verbal)

Bachelor’s Degree

At least 3 years of experience performing qualitative analysis

At least 1 year of experience performing project management

Master’s Degree in Business or quantitative field such as Finance, Economics, Physical Sciences, Math, Statistics, Engineering

Job Category

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Job Description: Product Management Director - Salesforce Success Plans

About The Team

The Customer Success (CS) Success Plan product management organization is responsible for managing Salesforce’s Customer Success Plan offer portfolio (Standard, Premier, and Signature Success Plans) with which we enable our customers to realize value from their Salesforce technology investments. We work backward from the customer to address their needs across all customer segments (Small Business, Commercial, and Enterprise) and across all Salesforce products. The team is the “voice of the customer and market” to the rest of the CS organization and we work across all functions within CS and the Salesforce product organizations to continuously enhance the customer value and experience delivered by the Success Plans offer portfolio.

About The Role

We're looking for a Product Management Director to build, justify, and operationalize changes to our Success Plans offers. This senior individual contributor (IC) role owns the path from evidence to execution: grounding decisions in customer and stakeholder research, developing and presenting the business cases — financial modeling included — that earn senior leadership alignment, and then owning the operating discipline that keeps those offers accountable once they're live, including feedback loops, performance reporting, and V2MOM updates. You'll also keep a close eye on industry trends, the competitive landscape, and Salesforce's AI roadmap, translating what you see into concrete implications, and drive growth and adoption of the Success Plan offers in market.

Ideal candidates have deep Salesforce platform knowledge, proven Product Management experience (ideally in Customer Success), a strong record of turning strategy into actionable roadmaps, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.

What You'll Do

Conduct customer and stakeholder research to understand needs, analyze feedback, and drive innovation.
Act as a thought leader and craft clear, concise and unbiased point of view documents on necessary changes to features, the portfolio, and the go-to-market (GTM) model.
Develop and present business cases for new offers or enhancements, including financial modeling, and secure senior leadership alignment.
Drive growth and adoption of the Success Plan offers
Own the operating rhythm behind the offer: feedback loops, offer performance reporting, and V2MOM updates, so the team stays accountable to its goals.
Stay ahead of industry trends, the competitive landscape, and Salesforce's own AI roadmap so you can proactively flag implications to Success Plans

Ideal Candidate Profile

Deep Salesforce Knowledge: You have a strong working knowledge of Salesforce products and a keen understanding of how enterprise software companies go to market.
A First-Principles Thinker: You don't just accept the status quo. You excel at breaking down ambiguous, complex business problems into their fundamental components and reassembling them into a coherent solution that is defensible with data.
Connect the Dots: You excel at systems thinking and can anticipate the second and third-order effects of a strategic decision. You naturally see how a change in one part of the business impacts another.
Proven Strategist: You have a background in management consulting, corporate strategy, or a product management role that was heavily focused on monetization and business strategy. You have a portfolio of work that demonstrates your ability to drive significant strategic change.
Exceptional Communicator: You are a clear, concise writer and presenter. You can create the definitive document that persuades executives and aligns disparate teams on a complex issue.
Problem-Solver at Heart: You are not content to simply identify problems; you are driven to design the solution and see it through.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management or Strategy, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
10+ years of product management experience, including packaging/pricing of B2B SaaS support, success, or services offerings
Track record owning a product line end-to-end — strategy, roadmap, GTM enablement, and post-launch iteration
Strong cross-functional influence skills — comfortable driving alignment across Sales, CS, and Marketing without direct reporting lines
Experience with subscription/tiered pricing models and customer retention/adoption metrics
Familiarity with how AI and agentic technologies (e.g., Agentforce) are changing customer adoption, enablement, and support needs — and how that translates into offer GTM decisions

Preferred Requirements

M.B.A.
Experience building or evolving offers/programs tied to AI-driven products, including how to measure and support customer success with agentic or generative AI capabilities

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

About Rimini Street, Inc.

Rimini Street, Inc. (Nasdaq: RMNI), a Russell 2000® Company, is a proven, trusted global provider of end-to-end, mission-critical enterprise software support, managed services and innovative Agentic AI ERP solutions, and is the leading third-party support provider for Oracle, SAP and VMware software.

Our comprehensive portfolio of unified solutions help run, manage, support, customize, configure, connect, protect, monitor, and optimize enterprise application, database and technology software, enabling our clients to achieve better business outcomes, significantly reduce costs and reallocate resources towards strategic projects.

The Company has signed thousands of contracts with Fortune Global 100, Fortune 500, midmarket, public sector and government organizations who selected Rimini Street as their trusted, proven mission-critical enterprise software solutions provider and achieved better operational outcomes, realized billions of US dollars in savings and funded AI and other innovation investments.

We are actively seeking an experienced Product Management Director
to join our team. This remote U.S.–based role will be responsible for Rimini Street’s services for enterprise security, interoperability and monitoring known as Rimini ProtectTM, Rimini ConnectTM and Rimini WatchTM . The position reports to the GVP, Product Management, Optimize Pillar.

Position Summary

The Product Management Director owns the offer portfolio for security, interoperability and monitoring solutions. This role is accountable for defining, evolving, expanding, and governing these offers to ensure they are clearly packaged, commercially viable, scalable, and consistently delivered across regions and products.

This is a Services-oriented Product Management role, and these services are sold together with our flagship Support and Managed Services, with a focus on on-premise Oracle and SAP, VMWare and other Rimini supported technologies and environments. This is an individual contributor role with no direct people-management responsibilities. The Director title reflects the seniority, experience, and level of strategic influence required for the position. The Director partners closely with the GM of the Rimini products, Delivery, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Product, and other stakeholders to align client needs, market opportunities, and delivery realities into offers to drive growth and client outcomes.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Global Offer Portfolio Management

Own the lifecycle of offers from definition through launch, adoption, performance measurement, continuous improvement, and retirement. Partner with GM of Products on roadmap and direction.
Identify portfolio gaps and growth opportunities using client demand signals, win/loss insights, sales feedback, and delivery experience.
Develop business cases for new offers or material changes, balancing client value, revenue opportunity, margin impact, and delivery feasibility.

Go-to-Market Leadership

Drive go-to-market activities for the Rimini ProtectTM, Rimini ConnectTM and Rimini WatchTM offer portfolio. Drive sales, cross-sell and adoption of services across global Large and Enterprise B2B customers.
Maintain an outbound Product Management focus by incorporating customer needs, market insights, sales feedback, and competitive dynamics into offer strategy.
Partner with Sales, Sales Enablement, and Marketing to ensure offers are easy to understand, position, and sell.
Define and track offer performance including bookings, revenue, attach rate, deal cycle time, adoption, and customer satisfaction.

Cross-Functional Leadership, Collaboration and Governance

Serve as a central point of accountability for offer decisions across products, regions, and stakeholders, including marketing, sales, finance, deal desk, product and technology.
Lead complex initiatives through influence without direct authority. Drive alignment through clear governance mechanisms and decision forums.

You'll own the roadmap for our accounting surface while also rolling up your sleeves to drive delivery. Trust Accounting Workflows

Own the product vision and roadmap for Rentvine's trust accounting engine — the ledger, reconciliation flows, month-end close, and compliance guardrails that property managers depend on daily.
Drive improvements to the monthly accounting workflow, reducing approval friction and surfacing anomalies earlier while preserving human oversight on high-value transactions.

AP/AR & Owner Disbursements

Own the end-to-end experience for accounts payable and receivable, including vendor payments, owner distributions, and tenant billing.
Identify friction in the disbursement workflow and deliver features that improve speed, accuracy, and transparency for property managers and their owners.
Work closely with customers to understand real-world pain points around payment timing, exceptions handling, and reporting.

AI & Automation in Accounting

Partner with Rentvine's AI Pod to identify high-value automation opportunities within accounting — from intelligent transaction categorization to anomaly detection to assisted reconciliation.
Define where AI creates genuine leverage (reducing tedious manual work, catching errors) vs. where human judgment must remain in the loop.
Help shape the product thinking around an accounting-focused agent workforce, with a bias toward augmenting — not replacing — the property manager's expertise.

Demonstrated ability to own both strategy (roadmap, vision) and execution (delivery, scoping, unblocking) — a genuine player-coach.

Direct experience with Rentvine, AppFolio, Buildium, or another property management platform.
